verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a harness-agnostic skills and workflow plugin for coding agents. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself letting users register or connect MCP servers to use their tools. Any MCP client support would come from the host harness (Claude Code, Codex, and others), which is a host-platform capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
